quotes.speaker: Andy Jassy
quotes.text: Our AWS investment in functionality and infrastructure is working, with over 39% year-over-year revenue growth in Q3 ($184 billion revenue run rate) and projected revenue growth rates of over 40% both in 2027 and in 2028. Our broader selection and speedier delivery are helping us capture more retail market segment share with improving margins, and our newer businesses, ranging from Grocery to Pharmacy to Amazon Leo to Zoox are progressing encouragingly. There has never been a trillion dollar revenue business, and we may have two of them in the next 5-10 years.

guidance.value: between $240.0 billion and $247.0 billion, or to grow between 12% and 16% compared with fourth quarter 2025
guidance.verbatim: Net sales are expected to be between $240.0 billion and $247.0 billion, or to grow between 12% and 16% compared with fourth quarter 2025.
Operating income is expected to be between $28.5 billion and $33.5 billion, compared with $25.0 billion in fourth quarter 2025.
We continue to expect 2026 cash capital expenditures to be approximately $220 billion.
We expect year-over-year advertising revenue to grow in the high teens in fourth quarter 2026.
